drhp.business: Titan Biotech, founded in 1992 as a culture media manufacturer, makes biological products using fermentation, hydrolysis and chemical processes; most of its products are intermediates used as ingredients in formulations, fermentation processing aids or culture media bases. It operates through its core ingredients business (food ingredients, protein and collagen products, nutraceutical and pharmaceutical ingredients, animal nutrition products) and its TM Media brand for diagnostics, covering dehydrated and ready-to-use culture media, media supplements, lab chemicals, lab consumables and equipment. It also produced viral transport kits under TM Media during the Covid-19 pandemic. The associate company Peptech Biosciences sells agricultural products on a B2B basis. The company sells in India and exports to more than 100 countries through distributors and direct customers. Its manufacturing is located in Bhiwadi, Rajasthan, where it has added an HVAC-equipped warehousing facility.
